sections: This procedure sets out how a HAZOP study is run on the invented unit. Its scope is every new process unit and its objective is to find hazards before start-up.
The study leader chairs every session. Team members come from the process, instrument and operations disciplines.
Before the study the P&IDs and the operating procedures shall be prepared and issued to the team.
The unit is divided into nodes, each a section of plant with one design intent.
Guidewords such as no, more and less are applied to each parameter to give deviations.
For every deviation the causes, the consequences and the safeguards are discussed and written down.
The worksheet has one row per deviation and an action column for recommendations.
Every recommendation is given a responsible person and a due date and is tracked until it is closed out.
A report is issued after the study and the records are retained for the life of the unit.
